title: סלמון
notes: Yellow memo card with a construction-company letterhead. The heading reads 'סלמון / [name]' (name after the slash uncertain), with a scribbled-out line under it. Only the heading name and the body lines are on the card; a faint mirror-image of the reverse side shows through the paper and is ignored.

Words 'להפשיר', 'לטבל בענפי שמיר' and 'עגבניות' were accepted after Gemini's second reading was checked against the zoomed ink (letter count and shapes are consistent); they remain a medium-confidence reading of shaky handwriting.

Gemini's title/lines 'סלמון בשקית קוקי', 'על הדג', 'מיץ מחצי לימון לשפוך מעל' and 'ולאפות בתנור' were NOT adopted: they do not match the visible ink (the card's last visible line begins 'נייר אפיה'), so they are only recorded in uncertainties.
Handwriting is very cramped/shaky; a human re-read (or rescan) of this card is recommended.
